description: The action vocabulary's content: the instances the `actions` query scope serves. Validates against `action.schema.json#/$defs/actions_payload`, which is the metaschema and holds no instances. Derivation and cadence: representation.md sections 6 and 7.

actions.description: Move to a target location, carrying whatever is held.

actions.description: Release custody of an element. The release half of the grasp/release pair.
